chapter: Leaving Duke and the Goodman sextet
title: Goodman's discipline and the big band
summary: Goodman rehearsed the band hard and everyone did as told; Cootie was used to discipline from Ellington.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Because he had all good men in the band.
And he rehearsed the band. And I mean, that band played. Wasn't no way any man could do what he wanted to do and this and that.
No. It wasn't going down like that.
No. Everybody was doing exactly what Goodman said.
And when that band hit, they hit.
And you weren't used to that.
Yeah, in a way I was. I always disciplined myself.
Because I was never late. I played with Ellington, what was it, 12 years, something like that? 10, 12 years. Never was late.
Never was late. And I was accustomed to those type of things.
And it didn't bother me at all. You know.
